client_visible_changes: 0.22.0 adds no route and preserves the 44 routes of 0.21.0 (ADR 0038). An exec or session start gains the optional writable_roots list, a closed union of {host, mount} naming an operator-declared host root and {workspace, mount} naming a Git checkout workspace, at most MAX_WRITABLE_ROOTS (8) entries; a start that names none serializes and hashes exactly as before. A request never carries a host path.

The capability facts object (schemas/capability.json) and the observed resource union (schemas/resource.json) are closed, and 0.22.0 adds the optional exec.writable-roots.host and exec.writable-roots.git facts to the one and, to an exec's applied confinement, an optional writable_roots member listing each bound root with its kind, its name or workspace id, the resolved host_path and its mount. A client that validates snapshots or resources against predecessor 0.21.0 rejects a snapshot that publishes either fact, or a record of a start that bound a writable root, until it moves to 0.22.0.
A workdir may now lie at or beneath a writable root mount; exec.workdir-outside-mounts keeps its 0.21.0 message.

Eight refusals are new: exec.writable-roots-exceeded, exec.writable-root-name-invalid, exec.writable-root-mount-invalid, exec.writable-root-mount-reserved, exec.writable-root-mount-duplicate and exec.writable-root-mount-overlap (422), checked before any capability, and exec.writable-roots-host-unserved and exec.writable-roots-git-unserved (501), whose message names the host root or workspace id no published fact serves.
